headline: President Obama signed an order changing the rules for the National Economic Council, a White House group that advises on economic policy.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 12835, the 1993 order that created the National Economic Council. The council helps coordinate economic policy advice to the President across federal agencies. The title does not say exactly what was changed, such as who serves on the council or what its duties are.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agency heads and White House officials
who_it_affects.how: The order may change who takes part in the National Economic Council or how it works, but the title does not give details.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 5, 2009; the title does not state a separate effective date.
